purpose: A dweet by Axioplase that no trip has started from today. I want to see another cat-free way to draw a tunnel.

pages.title: Dweet 36726 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A dweet with no cat in it, which is a start. Axioplase builds a tunnel out of nested loops and a hash of two cosines, then picks square sizes from a little table of primes. It is pretty and quick to read. I wanted the tunnel to be drawn by something less obvious, but the trick here is just bit-mixing …

pages.title: Dweet 36727 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A square wave built out of a Fourier series, drawn one point at a time. Cat-free, sure, but the tunnel itself is just a sine-ish curve with a fudge. Gear teeth at f=1 is a nice touch, I'll give it that. Modest, but I want to poke it.

pages.title: Dweet 36736 by Axioplase
pages.reaction: A grid of grey circles, each shade picked by a hash of its position, with every other row shifted half a step. No tunnel in sight, but the offset rows read like a brick wall seen from a train. Good, dense, a bit too clever for its own shorts. It is a dweet, so it has to fit in a …
